hero.description: Work where design and engineering meet, turning difficult product problems into clear, polished web experiences. I also build and contribute to open-source tools and write about what I learn along the way.
hero.personalDescriptionSuffix: , take photographs, play games, and watch films.

experience.title: Three products, each built around demanding day-to-day work.
experience.description: My professional work ranges from creating accessible UI interfaces to designing complex architecture for products where speed, clarity, and reliability directly affect how teams work.
experience.firstDescription: A visual builder with an AST compiler and parser, runtime renderer, and deployment pipeline — built from scratch for teams without dedicated engineers.
experience.firstOutcome: Three non-technical teams shipped seven full-stack applications independently.
experience.secondDescription: A shared workspace used across four business departments, supported by a reusable frontend platform and company-wide design system.
experience.secondOutcome: My design system now serves six teams across eight products.
experience.thirdDescription: Complex simulation interfaces for distributed engineering teams, including virtualized data views, schema-driven widgets, and role-based access.
experience.thirdOutcome: A new designed API around Playwright let 13 engineers author their own end-to-end tests and automated presentations without depending on the frontend or testing teams.

selectedWork.title: Products made to be useful and enjoyable to use.
selectedWork.description: My personal projects where I take care of the quality, interface, and engineering details from end to end.
selectedWork.firstDescription: A desktop music player based on Telegram API for people who want to own and organize their listening library without depending on a streaming service.
selectedWork.secondDescription: A toolchain for authoring a resume as structured HTML and reliably transforming it into a polished, portable PDF.
